coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 1 of 5 ground-truth variable items (20%): torsion-angle autocorrelation, whose cosine definition is recovered as the real part of the proposed complex correlation. The remaining items are missing or materially different.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the pooled 30k test-peptide frames and fixed training settings (256-residue crops, every-40-frame subsampling, full-protein inference). Replaces the specified 100 fs reference, 10 ps subsampling, and 100 fs upsampling comparison with primarily 1 fs reconstruction, multiple strides, and additional baselines. Uses a different autocorrelation lag range and omits dynamic content defined as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Does not state that MDGEN should recover sub-ps oscillations, closely match reference autocorrelation curves, and produce non-monotonic dynamic content, unlike subsampled trajectories.
